# tilelang 0.1.6 bundles its own libtvm.so (with internal TVMFFI symbols)
# which collides with flashinfer's apache-tvm-ffi at runtime
# (Conflicting static index 72 between ffi.Map and ffi.NDArray).
# 0.1.8+ moves to an external apache-tvm-ffi dep — same one flashinfer
# already pulls in — so the two coexist.  Constraint intersection:
# flashinfer 0.6.6 needs apache-tvm-ffi >=0.1.6,<0.2,!=0.1.8,!=0.1.8.post0;
# tilelang 0.1.9 needs apache-tvm-ffi >=0.1.2,~=0.1.0; both satisfied by
# 0.1.8.post2 (which is what already ships in the lock).
# See docs/dsv4/B200/tvm_ffi_collision.md for the full diagnosis.
tilelang==0.1.9
